querySnapshot.announce: not a heavy scan, 76 index probes plus two instrument-fire controls. Unique index atoms_entity_composite_unique ON public.atoms USING btree (entity_type, entity_id).
querySnapshot.missingCountSql: SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS missing_n FROM county_manifest m WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM county_facet_coverage c WHERE c.county_fips = m.county_fips AND c.facet = 'flood')
querySnapshot.missingListSql: SELECT m.county_fips, m.county_name FROM county_manifest m WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM county_facet_coverage c WHERE c.county_fips = m.county_fips AND c.facet = 'flood') ORDER BY m.county_fips
querySnapshot.parcelExistsSql: SELECT m.county_fips, m.county_name, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM txgio_parcel p WHERE p.county_fips = m.county_fips) AS has_txgio_parcel FROM county_manifest m WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM county_facet_coverage c WHERE c.county_fips = m.county_fips AND c.facet = 'flood') ORDER BY m.county_fips
querySnapshot.existsSql: SELECT v.fips, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM atoms a WHERE a.entity_type = 'flood-hazard-fact' AND a.entity_id >= v.fips || ':' AND a.entity_id < v.fips || ';') AS has_flood_atoms FROM (VALUES (...76 fips excluding 48129...)) AS v(fips)
querySnapshot.floodGroupBy: none. Never GROUP BY all flood-hazard-fact rows.
